goal: Independently review the exact BTE and IOLM owner-response requests and return digest-bound candidate response content without writing canonical owner outputs or claiming owner acceptance.
context: The eleven BTE requested output paths are absent. The direct owner decision keeps IOLM DSC-A as the predecessor but explicitly leaves its passing receipt missing. The review must inspect both request contracts, their live bindings, the null owner-response templates, current implementation evidence, and relevant Inventory precedents. Each reviewer attacks the complete corpus, specializes in one evidence lane, and returns exact candidate content or a defended block. The parent may package verbatim returns as proposal evidence only; canonical owner outputs remain gated on later exact-byte owner acceptance.
anti_bias_global: claim-bound evidence production versus authority-bound owner acceptance

groups.anti_bias: methodology (formal provenance reconstruction versus adversarial consumer-conformance replay)

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 reconstructs BTE catalogue and admission provenance while Agent 1 adversarially tests IOLM consumer-conformance and no-substitution boundaries on the methodology axis; BTE-local sufficiency bias in Agent 0 is exposed by Agent 1's external-consumer evidence requirement, while IOLM-only gate bias in Agent 1 is exposed by Agent 0's exact 17/17 denominator reconstruction.

agents.angle: formal BTE provenance reconstruction for eleven freeze, admission, and catalogue candidates with exact 17/17 membership including creates
agents.initial_prompt: Read the full admitted corpus named in the dispatch briefing, including both BTE and IOLM requests, but specialize in the BTE prerequisite contract. Verify every bound input digest and live byte size; inspect the current BTE implementation, validators, catalogues, formation surfaces, relationship registry, candidate profile, and existing reconciliations needed to determine whether each of the eleven requested outputs can honestly be proposed. Reconstruct the exact 17 relationship IDs in order and preserve formation-criterion@1 denominator 16, formation-structure@1 denominator 13, node-kind-causality@1 denominator 13, relationship-family-causality@1 denominator 17, plus exact build node/edge IDs. Return one JSON-compatible object in chat with task_status, domain_gate_status, lane_id, source_bindings, requested_output_checks, exact_17_relationship_ids, candidate_responses, validation_commands, findings, missing_evidence, blockers, residue, and authority_ceiling_check. Each candidate response must contain every field required by the source request or explain exactly why it cannot be authored. Use task_status completed only when the audit and candidate drafting are complete; domain_gate_status must remain candidate-awaiting-exact-owner-acceptance unless independently owned canonical response bytes already exist and prove otherwise. Do not write files, impersonate a human owner, claim admission/release/readiness, accept or apply the 13-postimage proposal, mutate Git/telemetry/Inventory/Craft, or copy private material into public Arcanum.

agents.angle: adversarial IOLM DSC-A consumer-conformance replay with exact upstream handle, provenance, validation, and no-planning-owner-substitution checks
agents.initial_prompt: Read the full admitted corpus named in the dispatch briefing, including both BTE and IOLM requests, but specialize in the private IOLM DSC-A predecessor. Verify the current consumer contract digest, the direct owner decision that keeps DSC-A, the exact upstream EVF handle requirements, the current IOLM work-pack/session evidence, and every runnable validation needed to determine whether a passing DSC-A response can honestly be proposed. Attempt no product mutation. Return one JSON-compatible object in chat with task_status, domain_gate_status, lane_id, source_bindings, consumer_contract_check, upstream_handle_check, candidate_response, validation_commands, findings, missing_evidence, blockers, dsc_b_effect, residue, and authority_ceiling_check. The candidate response must contain owner_identity, decision, exact_path, sha256, size_bytes, bound_upstream_handle, validation, and authority_effect, or explain exactly why one or more fields cannot be authored. Use task_status completed only when the audit and candidate drafting are complete; domain_gate_status must remain candidate-awaiting-exact-owner-acceptance unless an independently authored passing DSC-A receipt already exists and proves otherwise. Do not write files, synthesize or impersonate owner evidence, change the predecessor, claim DSC-A pass from a decision record, accept/apply proposal bytes, grant readiness/release, mutate Git/telemetry/Inventory/Craft, or expose private material through public Arcanum.
